en.text: In the fourth year of King Darius, the LORD’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.

zhSimplified.text: 大流士王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和华的话临到撒迦利亚。

zhTraditional.text: 大流士王第四年九月，就是基斯流月初四日，耶和華的話臨到撒迦利亞。

en.text: The people of Bethel sent Sharezer and Regem Melech and their men to entreat the LORD’s favor,

zhSimplified.text: 那时伯特利人已经打发沙利色和利坚米勒，并跟从他们的人，去恳求耶和华的恩，

zhTraditional.text: 那時伯特利人已經打發沙利色和利堅米勒，並跟從他們的人，去懇求耶和華的恩，

en.text: and to speak to the priests of the house of the LORD of Armies and to the prophets, saying, “Should I weep in the fifth month, separating myself, as I have done these so many years?”

zhSimplified.text: 并问万军之耶和华殿中的祭司和先知说：「我历年以来，在五月间哭泣斋戒，现在还当这样行吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 並問萬軍之耶和華殿中的祭司和先知說：「我歷年以來，在五月間哭泣齋戒，現在還當這樣行嗎？」

en.text: Then the word of the LORD of Armies came to me, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华的话就临到我说：

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華的話就臨到我說：

en.text: “Speak to all the people of the land and to the priests, saying, ‘When you fasted and mourned in the fifth and in the seventh month for these seventy years, did you at all fast to me, really to me?

zhSimplified.text: 「你要宣告国内的众民和祭司，说：『你们这七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，岂是丝毫向我禁食吗？

zhTraditional.text: 「你要宣告國內的眾民和祭司，說：『你們這七十年，在五月、七月禁食悲哀，豈是絲毫向我禁食嗎？

en.text: When you eat and when you drink, don’t you eat for yourselves and drink for yourselves?

zhSimplified.text: 你们吃喝，不是为自己吃，为自己喝吗？

zhTraditional.text: 你們吃喝，不是為自己吃，為自己喝嗎？

en.text: Aren’t these the words which the LORD proclaimed by the former prophets when Jerusalem was inhabited and in prosperity, and its cities around her, and the South and the lowland were inhabited?’”

zhSimplified.text: 当耶路撒冷和四围的城邑有居民，正兴盛，南地高原有人居住的时候，耶和华借从前的先知所宣告的话，你们不当听吗？』」

zhTraditional.text: 當耶路撒冷和四圍的城邑有居民，正興盛，南地高原有人居住的時候，耶和華藉從前的先知所宣告的話，你們不當聽嗎？』」

en.text: The LORD’s word came to Zechariah, saying,

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华的话又临到撒迦利亚说：

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華的話又臨到撒迦利亞說：

en.text: “Thus has the LORD of Armies spoken, saying, ‘Execute true judgment, and show kindness and compassion every man to his brother.

zhSimplified.text: 「万军之耶和华曾对你们的列祖如此说：『要按至理判断，各人以慈爱怜悯弟兄。

zhTraditional.text: 「萬軍之耶和華曾對你們的列祖如此說：『要按至理判斷，各人以慈愛憐憫弟兄。

en.text: Don’t oppress the widow, the fatherless, the foreigner, nor the poor; and let none of you devise evil against his brother in your heart.’

zhSimplified.text: 不可欺压寡妇、孤儿、寄居的，和贫穷人。谁都不可心里谋害弟兄。』」

zhTraditional.text: 不可欺壓寡婦、孤兒、寄居的，和貧窮人。誰都不可心裏謀害弟兄。』」

en.text: But they refused to listen, and turned their backs, and stopped their ears, that they might not hear.

zhSimplified.text: 他们却不肯听从，扭转肩头，塞耳不听，

zhTraditional.text: 他們卻不肯聽從，扭轉肩頭，塞耳不聽，

en.text: Yes, they made their hearts as hard as flint, lest they might hear the law and the words which the LORD of Armies had sent by his Spirit by the former prophets. Therefore great wrath came from the LORD of Armies.

zhSimplified.text: 使心硬如金钢石，不听律法和万军之耶和华用灵借从前的先知所说的话。故此，万军之耶和华大发烈怒。

zhTraditional.text: 使心硬如金鋼石，不聽律法和萬軍之耶和華用靈藉從前的先知所說的話。故此，萬軍之耶和華大發烈怒。

en.text: It has come to pass that, as he called and they refused to listen, so they will call and I will not listen,” said the LORD of Armies;

zhSimplified.text: 万军之耶和华说：「我曾呼唤他们，他们不听；将来他们呼求我，我也不听！

zhTraditional.text: 萬軍之耶和華說：「我曾呼喚他們，他們不聽；將來他們呼求我，我也不聽！

en.text: “but I will scatter them with a whirlwind among all the nations which they have not known. Thus the land was desolate after them, so that no man passed through nor returned; for they made the pleasant land desolate.”

zhSimplified.text: 我必以旋风吹散他们到素不认识的万国中。这样，他们的地就荒凉，甚至无人来往经过，因为他们使美好之地荒凉了。」

zhTraditional.text: 我必以旋風吹散他們到素不認識的萬國中。這樣，他們的地就荒涼，甚至無人來往經過，因為他們使美好之地荒涼了。」
